import ctypes
import os

# Load the libraries
ctypes.CDLL('/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgslcblas.so', mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
gsl = ctypes.CDLL('/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgsl.so')

# Define the function prototype
# double gsl_ran_erlang_pdf(const double x, const double a, const double n)
gsl.gsl_ran_erlang_pdf.argtypes = [ctypes.c_double, ctypes.c_double, ctypes.c_double]
gsl.gsl_ran_erlang_pdf.restype = ctypes.c_double

def erlang_pdf(x, a, n):
    """Compute the Erlang PDF using GSL's C function."""
    return gsl.gsl_ran_erlang_pdf(x, a, n)

    assert abs(result - expected) < 1e-9, f"Test case 2 failed: {result} != {expected}"
